name: Jim Blackburn
background: Theodore “Jim” Blackburn of Cheyenne served in the Wyoming House from 2015 to 2022, representing House District 42. The 2021–22 legislative directory said he was born July 2, 1943, at Fort Francis E. Warren, Wyoming; identified him as a retired real-estate broker; and recorded U.S. Navy service. It said he was married to his wife, Judy, and had three children and nine grandchildren.

sources.name: Wyoming Trucking Association and Associated General Contractors of Wyoming, 2021–2022 Directory of the Sixty-Sixth Legislature
